title: Totals counter
counts: One added to a screen's total for the day (UTC date) each time that screen opens.
switch_on: Create a Supabase project in eu-west-2 (London) used for nothing else.
Run docs/counter/schema.sql in its SQL editor.
Sign off docs/dpia-totals-counter.md (owner, with the date).
Put the project URL (https://<ref>.supabase.co) and its publishable key (sb_publishable_...) in this file, set status to on, rebuild and publish.
switch_off: Empty endpoint and key, set status to off, rebuild and publish. The page then sends nothing anywhere.
